journal.clue: Transport orders route heartglass via the Rootward sluices, north of Veyr.
log: Report to Crown Quarry's gate, north of town.
Go north to the quarry gate. Mara is counting her crew.
Find Mara's seven workers below Crown Quarry, then get them out.
Get the workers out through the Lift Yard, east of the face.
Report to the ministry in Veyr, south across the river.
Find a way out of the Intake Hall.
Take the ledgers from the Ledger Stacks, then leave by the canal.
Leave the Underways by the canal. The ledger points to Rootward.
Reach the canal exit east of the seal chamber.
Follow the ledger to the Rootward sluices, just north.
Repair the irrigation at the Three Sluices, north of the Root Ford.
Follow the raised root bridges to the Hollow Grove.
Take the northern road to Cinderwake in Cinder Reach.
Enter the Furnace Spine (east gate) and vent the pressure lines into empty chambers.
Balance the red and blue lines, venting into empty chambers.
Shut the regulator down by hand in the cooling garden beyond.
Follow the shipping manifest east to Bellharbor on the Glass Coast.
Recover Pip's confiscated ledger from the customs house (south-west of the quay).
Bring the ledger to Jori's office in Chartmaker Lane.
Reach the Drowned Archive, south-east along the coast from Bellharbor, at low water.
Open the Bell Nave's galleries by matching bell tones to their doors.
Speak with Rook in the Witness Vault.
Take the coastal ferry north to Skyspine (east pier on the world road), then the Skychain Viaduct.
Cross the Skychain: lock the ballast in the yard, then cross the span to the Chain Nest.
Continue to the High Landing, north-east of the nest.
Visit High Aerie (north), then take the cable ferry west to the Pale Basin.
journal.objective: Visit High Aerie (north), then take the cable ferry west to the Pale Basin.
rumors: An old quarryman says the heartglass started humming after the regulators arrived.
Bellharbor dock workers say the ministry is hunting a forger who turns refugees into 'cargo'.
Pip says the Drowned Archive opens its tide door at low water, south-east of Bellharbor.
Sailors say the Skychain's anchors failed; High Aerie is sending a volunteer to reset them alone.
Corren says the wind shrine above High Aerie's stair is older than the Crown.
